title: Algebraically closed overfields with a prescribed cardinal transcendence bound
statement: Let $E$ be a field [def-weil-field]. There exist an algebraically closed field $K$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and a field embedding $\sigma:E\hookrightarrow K$ [def-pc-field-extension] such that $$\max(\aleph_0,|E|)<\operatorname{trdeg}_{P}K,$$ where $P\subseteq K$ is the prime subfield (the smallest subfield containing $1$), $\operatorname{trdeg}$ is cardinal transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree], $|E|$ is the cardinality of the underlying set of $E$, and $\aleph_0=|\mathbf N|$. Cardinalities are compared in one common universe.

source.place: Tag 04LR (lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points), proof, construction (1): algebraically closed field of very large transcendence degree; here applied with E as the base field.

proof.text: Work in a universe $\mathcal U$ containing $E$ and $\mathbf N$, and put $\kappa=\max(\aleph_0,|E|)$, a cardinal of $\mathcal U$ with $\aleph_0\leq\kappa$. Let $\lambda=\kappa^+$ be its successor cardinal, the least cardinal of $\mathcal U$ strictly greater than $\kappa$. It exists because the cardinals of $\mathcal U$ are well ordered and the power set of a set of cardinality $\kappa$ lies in $\mathcal U$ and has cardinality $2^\kappa>\kappa$ by Cantor's diagonal argument. Thus $\aleph_0\leq\kappa<\lambda$, and $\lambda$ is an infinite cardinal in $\mathcal U$. Only these elementary size facts are used.

source.place: Tag 04LR (lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points), proof, construction (1); agent expansion using cardinal enlargement and cardinality of transcendence bases.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-algclosed-extension-cardinal-lower-bound] to the field $E$ and the infinite cardinal $\lambda$. It supplies a $\mathcal U$-small algebraically closed extension $K/E$ with $\lambda\leq|K|$. Its structural map $\sigma:E\to K$ is an embedding by [def-pc-field-extension]. Consequently $\aleph_0\leq\kappa<\lambda\leq|K|$, so $K$ is uncountable.

source.place: Tag 04LR (lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points), proof, construction (1); agent expansion using cardinal enlargement and cardinality of transcendence bases.

proof.text: Let $P\subseteq K$ be the prime subfield. By [lem-sfb-prime-subfield-countable], $|P|\leq\aleph_0$. Apply [lem-exc-transcendence-basis-exists] to the inclusion $P\to K$, obtaining a transcendence basis $b:I\to K$. Now [lem-weil-countable-base-transcendence-cardinality] applies: the base $P$ is countable, and $K$ is algebraically closed and uncountable by step 2. It gives $|I|=|K|$. The definition [def-kun-transcendence-degree] identifies $|I|$ with $\operatorname{trdeg}_P K$, hence $\operatorname{trdeg}_P K=|K|$.

source.place: Tag 04LR (lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points), proof, construction (1); agent expansion using cardinal enlargement and cardinality of transcendence bases.

proof.text: Combine the preceding inequalities and equality: $\max(\aleph_0,|E|)=\kappa<\lambda\leq|K|=\operatorname{trdeg}_P K$. The field $K$ and embedding $\sigma$ of step 2 therefore satisfy every clause of the statement. Every size comparison takes place in $\mathcal U$.
